jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: OUR COMPANYBoehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionDo you have a keen sense for navigating complex legal matters and want to contribute to securing freedom to operate and defending market exclusivity for highly innovative pharmaceuticals?Are you excited by the prospect of taking on responsibility and working in a highly dynamic environment as part of the Corporate Department of Boehringer Ingelheim being responsible for intellectual property?In this exciting position located in Ingelheim, you will play a key role in supporting our human pharma and animal health business in bringing innovative products to the patients in need.Join us to shape the future of Boehringer Ingelheim!Tasks & responsibilities- In this role, you will leverage your extensive legal expertise to mitigate launch risks from third party patents for our newly developed products as well as to enforce and defend our patents to defend our products against patent infringement.- With a strategic mindset, you will develop complex launch risk mitigation strategies in a cross functional set up and provide tailored advice to the business how to leverage upside potential from our existing patent portfolios.- Managing and instructing our network of external lawyers and patent attorneys in disputes including in-court infringement and nullity proceedings will be a key part of your responsibilities.- In addition, you will support the negotiation and drafting of complex agreements to find the best possible solutions for Boehringer Ingelheim.Requirements- Fully qualified lawyer, preferably with honors in the second state examination. An additional qualification (LL.M. or comparable degree with a focus on IP law) is desirable- Longterm specialization in the field of intellectual property and the pharmaceutical industry at an international level as well as extensive experience in managing large international IP portfolios- Longterm relevant professional experience in external law firms specialized on patent litigation or in a comparable in-house position as a corporate counsel- Experience in leading, coordinating, and managing patent litigation- Knowledge and experience in the pharmaceutical industry- Strong strategic understanding and the ability to quickly grasp and clearly present legally and technically complex matters- High level of teamwork and excellent communication skills in English and GermanWhat we offerWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until January 8, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.Step 2: Virtual meetingStep 3: On-site interviewsPlease include the following documents when applying for this position: References (e.g. high school diploma, university degree certificate and employment references)

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Global Security - People Protection (Sicherheitsmanager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.Tasks & responsibilities- As a subject matter expert, you'll strategically protect Boehringer's people and assets, developing and implementing security policies and standards to strengthen future resilience.- Drawing on your expertise, you'll drive projects, fostering an agile security culture and delivering true business value as a business enabler.- As a subject matter expert, you'll coordinate and support Boehringer globally, monitoring compliance, supporting local workflows, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to uphold a strong security culture & awareness.- As a service delivery lead, you will ensure with the vendors, performance and efficiency by measuring through structured KPIs and other service monitoring.- You'll identify optimization opportunities to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of security services, strategies, and processes, while ensuring global process standardization and compliance.- You'll take on a leadership role in sharing best practices, fostering a community of security professionals, and aligning user requirements with stakeholders worldwide.- Drive security awareness campaigns globally and ensure end-to-end delivery to the sites.Requirements- Armed with a master's degree in a security-related field, you're adept at conflict management and uphold a strong ethical code- Your comprehensive knowledge of protecting employees, assets, and business processes is coupled with resilience and intercultural competency- Expertise in site security management, operational and from management perspective is your forte, along with a knack for various security areas- Top-notch MS Office skills and exceptional negotiation abilities define you- Experience in instructing and coaching internal and external colleagues- You're fluent in English and basic German, with any additional languages as a bonusDrive the future of global security at Boehringer Ingelheim, leading projects and initiatives that enhance our site security, crisis readiness and foster resilience. You'll define requirements for people protection with focus on employee security, security policies and standards that protect our people and assets, while fostering a culture of innovation and agility in security. Based in our dynamic and collaborative environment, you'll deliver global security standards that truly add value to our business, influencing both internal and external stakeholders.Shape the future of security at Boehringer Ingelheim and contribute to a safer, more resilient workplace - we're looking forward to your application!As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until December 15th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to December 2nd, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.Step 2: Virtual meeting beginning / mid of JanuaryStep 3: On-site interviews mid / end of January

jobs.occupation: Senior Brand and Trade Marketing Specialist (Fachwirt/in - Marketing/Bachelor Professional in Marketing)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Brand Manager; Trade Marketing Manager; Senior Brand and Trade Marketing SpecialistStellenbeschreibung:At INABA-FOODS (Europe) GmbH, we are passionate about delivering premium pet food products that customers and pets love. As part of our continued growth across Europe, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Senior Brand & Trade Marketing Specialist Europe (m/f/d) to strengthen our brand, drive impactful marketing initiatives, and contribute to INABA’s continued growth across the European market. If you enjoy turning creative ideas into action, driving continuous improvement, and working in a dynamic, international environment where every day brings new challenges and opportunities, we’d love to hear from you!Your Role: take ownership of key European marketing projects: from shaping our innovation pipeline and coordinating new product launches, to strengthening brand consistency across markets and improving the way our brands come to life at the point of sale.Key Responsibilities:- Lead the European new product launch process, identifying opportunities from our global portfolio.- Develop the launch roadmap and coordinate launches with Japan HQ and European markets.- Support European markets in delivering consistent and impactful brand execution across different touchpoints.- Drive best practices for in-store activations, displays and point-of-sale (POS) materials.- Develop solutions that strengthen brand visibility while supporting local commercial needs.- Supporting account reconciliations and general accounting activities.- Establish a structured approach to evaluating promotional activities.- Identify learnings across markets and translate insights into recommendations for future activations and marketing investment.Your Profile:- 10+ years of relevant experience in Brand Management, Trade Marketing, Innovation or broader Marketing roles, ideally within FMCG.- Strong understanding of brand building and trade marketing, combined with a commercial mindset.- Experience working across multiple markets or in an international environment.- Proven ability to independently lead complex projects and coordinate multiple stakeholders.- A balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution.- Strong communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.- Excellent organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.- Proactive, pragmatic and comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving organisation.- Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage.- Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills.We offer:- A permanent employment contract in an international working environment- A responsible position with significant room for initiative and creativity- Comprehensive onboarding and opportunities for professional and personal development- A motivated team within a dynamic and rapidly growing market environment- Modern office in the heart of Düsseldorf city centre- Regular working hours from Monday to FridayReady to Make a Difference?Apply now and become part of our INABA-FOODS Europe team!Have we sparked your interest? We would be delighted to hear from you! Please send your application to recruiting@inaba-foods.co.jpWe kindly ask you to submit your application in English whenever possible, including:- Your CV (résumé)- Relevant employment references and certificates- A short cover letter outlining your motivation for applyingWe look forward to receiving your application!Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Performance-MarketingExpertenkenntnisse: Tabellenkalkulation Excel (MS Office), Kommunikationskonzept (erstellen, weiterentwickeln etc.), Kommunikationsstrategie (entwickeln, gestalten etc.), Unternehmenskommunikation, Corporate Identity, Marktforschung

jobs.occupation: AI Value Creation und Strategy Lead (all genders welcome) (Bachelor Professional - Künstliche Intelligenz und Maschinelles Lernen)
jobs.description: CompanyThe Business Unit Materials is the largest business unit within tk accelis, operating a leading materials distribution and material-related service network with a strong presence across Europe and North America and global capabilities. Combining scale, local market presence, and deep industry expertise, we deliver a broad portfolio of materials and value-added services to customers across diverse industrial sectors. Building on our strong market position, we are continuously expanding our service and manufacturing capabilities to create additional customer value and drive sustainable growth.Your responsibilitiesAs AI Value Creation und Strategy Lead, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing the AI transformation of BU Materials. Working closely with senior leadership and business stakeholders, you will identify opportunities to create business value through AI, define the strategic direction and help drive initiatives from idea to sustainable implementation.As part of the newly established AI und Value Acceleration Office, you will help shape and drive the AI agenda across BU Materials. Your responsibilities will include:- Defining and continuously evolving the BU AI strategy, roadmap and operating model- Identifying, evaluating and prioritizing AI opportunities across business functions and operating units- Establishing governance, decision frameworks and portfolio management processes for AI initiatives- Driving the successful integration of AI into business processes through leadership engagement, change initiatives and cross-functional collaboration- Identifying and accelerating high-impact opportunities, quick wins and scalable use cases to build momentum and demonstrate the business value of AI- Developing future-state concepts for functions, processes, skills and organizational capabilities- Building business cases and value realization frameworks together with Finance and Controlling- Advising senior leaders on transformation implications, workforce evolution and future operating models- Creating transparency on AI opportunities, risks, investments and realized benefits- Leading and orchestrating strategic cross-functional AI initiatives across business units, corporate functions and external partnersYour profile- University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Strategy, Organizational Development or a related field- Extensive professional experience in strategy consulting, business transformation, digital transformation, AI transformation or comparable strategic roles- Understanding of AI, automation and digital technologies and their impact on business processes and operating models- Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities to create business value through AI, digital solutions or process transformation- Proven track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives in an international environment- Ability to translate emerging technologies into business implications and strategic actions- Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working with senior executives- Excellent analytical and conceptual thinking capabilities- Willingness to travel internationally and work effectively across diverse cultural and business environments- Fluent English skills; German is an advantageYou don‘t meet all the criteria but still want to be part of tk accelis? We look forward to getting to know you.Your benefits- A highly visible strategic role with direct exposure to the BU Board and the opportunity to shape the AI transformation of BU Materials- A unique opportunity to shape a newly established AI und Value Acceleration Office and influence how AI creates measurable business value across BU Materials- Unique international exposure across businesses in Asia, Europe and North America- Attractive benefits, such as an excellent company pension plan- Flexible work schedules, remote work, and a variety of health promotion programs- A modern workplace at the ruhr tech kampus in Essen with a cafeteria, a café, free parking, and good public transportation accessHave we piqued your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application via the “Apply Now” button!ContactHeiko BergerHead of Sourcing und Recruiting+49 201 844576602We kindly ask companies in the direct recruitment sector to refrain from making inquiries.We value diversityWe value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity.

jobs.occupation: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG: Experienced Program Manager 22FDX (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
jobs.employer_name: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: About GFGlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.Your Job- You will be the responsible Program Manager for Technology Development Programs within GlobalFoundries' state-of-the-art 300 mm wafer fab (Fab1) in Dresden, Germany.- Plan and manage the execution for complex semiconductor engineering development programs.- Own the overall program schedule, resource allocation and alignment of program Milestone deliverables.- Ensure seamless transition from development phase into production.- Lead a cross-functional team of experts throughout the entire Technology Development Program defining tasks & work packages for in-time & in-quality program completion.- Work closely with Product Management, PMO, PDK, Modeling and IP Teams.- Communicate effectively internally as well as with customers within technical and executive forums. Required Qualifications- Masters/ Diploma degree in Engineering or Science (e.g. Physics, Chemistry, Materials) and/ or PhD.- Solid working knowledge of modern CMOS process integration.- Being a teamplayer with good oral and written communication skills in English are required.- Strong analytical, problem solving and project management skills.- You must have several years of experience in technical leadership roles within the semiconductor industry.- Track record in Technology Development and/or program management of complex, cross-functional engineering programs.- Experience in “More than Moore” development efforts like Embedded Memory, High-Voltage or RF/mmWave are a plus.- Fluent in English Language – written & verbal, Proficiency in German language is a plus.- Exposure to semiconductor volume manufacturing methods, statistical methods, FMEA/8D Methodology, external customer & multicultural working environment is beneficial.- Project Management Certification (eg. IPMA, PMP) is a plus.We Offer  The position is open-ended and to be filled as soon as possible.  Attractive compensation components:   13th month salary, bonus payments, assistance with relocation to Dresden.  Flexible working time arrangements:   Family friendly part-time models, trust flextime, salary conversion into free time  Diverse opportunities for further development:   Career stages for every job, internal qualification offers, promotion of external educational qualifications  Focus on your health:   On-site gym and beach volleyball court, bike leasing, subsidized employee restaurant  Corporate culture:   Cooperation at eye level - everyone is on first name terms with us, budget for individual team events, social commitment via GlobalGives  You can find more benefits in detail at  hier  Diversity is part of our corporate DNA. For this reason, we would like to encourage women in particular to apply for a job with us. As we value equal opportunities and inclusion is particularly important to us, we welcome applications from people with disabilities.The job advertisement refers to a position up to job level 8 on the Engineering career ladder.Information about our benefits you can find here: hierSchlagworte: CHIP,Englisch, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309601/experienced-program-manager-22fdx (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309601/experienced-program-manager-22fdx#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenÜber GFGlobalFoundries (GF) ist ein führender Hersteller von Halbleitern, auf die sich die Welt zum Leben, Arbeiten und Vernetzen verlässt. Wir sind innovativ und arbeiten mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um energieeffizientere und leistungsfähigere Produkte für die Automobilindustrie, intelligente mobile Geräte, das Internet der Dinge (IoT), Kommunikationsinfrastrukturen und andere wachstumsstarke Märkte zu entwickeln.Mit unserem globalen Produktionsnetzwerk, das sich über die USA, Europa und Asien erstreckt, sind wir eine vertrauenswürdige und zuverlässige Quelle für Kunden in aller Welt. Jeden Tag liefert unser talentiertes und vielfältiges Team Ergebnisse mit einem unnachgiebigen Fokus auf Sicherheit, Langlebigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. GF beschäftigt weltweit rund 13.000 Mitarbeitende, davon 3.000 in Dresden. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.gf.com.

jobs.occupation: TOKYO ELECTRON: Field Service Engineer Etch Systems (Mikrotechnologe/-technologin - Halbleitertechnik)
jobs.description: Job DescriptionResponsibilities• Performs on-site installation, service, modification, and repair of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.• Troubleshoots equipment problems.• Maintains records and reports as required.• Coordinates activities with peers, supervisor(s) and customers to minimize equipment downtime and interruptions.• Orders and installs parts.• Responds to emergency service calls as required.• Instructs customer operating technicians on system operation and maintenance.• Performs upgrades and modifications to equipment as needed.• Remains current on equipment/tools through appropriate training, manuals, factory periodicals, and other relevant materials.• Incumbents are responsible for the upkeep, maintenance and security of company property including vehicles, tools, etc.• Employees must also maintain standards of conduct acceptable to both TEL and customers to maintain credentials for being on customer site(s).Typical Education and Experience• Qualification in Engineering, Electronics or related field or related experience• Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues.• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.• Basic understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and equipment.• Excellent communication in English and German and interpersonal skills to work effectively with customers and team members.• Willingness to travel• Valid driver’s licenseIndividual pay is determined based on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skills, job-related knowledge, relevant education, certifications, and/or training. In addition to base salary, we offer (full time regular employees ) a comprehensive benefits package and for certain roles eligibility in our bonus plan and long-term incentives as applicable. The talent advisor can share more details about total compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.Tokyo Electron Limited (TEL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). As such, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, belief, gender, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, membership to a traveller community or any other legally protected characteristic. TEL acknowledges that diversity creates an innovative culture and aims to create a workplace where everyone is treated fairly and can succeed based on merit and qualifications.SubsidiaryTokyo Electron Europe Ltd. – German BranchSchlagworte: CHIP,Englisch, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309605/field-service-engineer-etch-systems (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309605/field-service-engineer-etch-systems#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenKarriere bei Tokyo Electron: Gemeinsam die Zukunft gestaltenTokyo Electron ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter innovativer Produktionssysteme für die Halbleiterindustrie. Mit mehr als 18.000 Mitarbeitenden in 19 Ländern setzen wir Standards in der Entwicklung hochqualitativer Technologien und gestalten maßgeblich die Zukunft mit High-Tech-Anlagen für die nächste Chipgeneration.In Europa haben wir seit 1994 unsere Aktivitäten ausgeweitet und sind hier in 9 Ländern mit ca. 800 Mitarbeitenden tätig. Unser Geschäft konzentriert sich auf den Vertrieb und Service unserer Produktionsanlagen. Wir beraten und unterstützen unsere Kunden vor Ort, damit diese ihre Ziele in Chipdesign und Qualität bestmöglich erreichen. Eine gute Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden ist hierfür entscheiden, genauso wie unser intensiver Austausch mit unserem Hauptsitz in Japan und den weltweiten Produktionsstandorten von Tokyo Electron.Unsere deutsche Niederlassung, mit Sitz in Dresden, betreut die Installation, Wartung und Optimierung modernster TEL-Systeme in Deutschland. jobs.occupation: Research assistant (f/m/d) - Department of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: In the Department of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology in the Group of Electronic Measurement and Signal Processing at the Technische Universität Ilmenau (Germany) is a vacancy for aResearch assistant (f/m/d)as a Hardware Integration Engineer for 6G Research Platformsas soon as possible.How do groundbreaking wireless ideas become real-world prototypes? Every new communication technology begins as a concept. Turning that concept into a working prototype requires engineers who can integrate cutting-edge hardware, connect complex measurement systems, and transform individual components into a reliable research platform.Our research group develops advanced prototypes for 6G communications, Integrated Communications and Sensing (ISAC), localization, and wireless channel measurements. These systems combine state-of-the-art RF equipment, FPGA platforms, embedded devices, sensors, and high-performance computing into experimental demonstrators that enable tomorrow's wireless technologies.As part of our hardware integration team, you will help design, assemble, and validate experimental platforms used in national and international research projects. You will work closely with researchers and software developers to integrate new hardware, automate measurements, and ensure that our demonstrators operate reliably in laboratory and field environments. Your work will directly support cutting-edge research and will become part of the infrastructure used by researchers and industrial partners.Your tasksYour job tasks includes the following responsibilities:- Conceptual design and methodological integration of complex RF measurement technology, FPGA, and embedded system architectures to enhance measurement accuracy in novel research setups- Methodological Validation and Scientific Evaluation of Experimental Demonstrators for Verifying Theoretical Models in the Field of Communication and Sensor Systems- Planning, implementation, and metrological monitoring of laboratory and field campaigns, as well as scientific analysis of the experimental data sets- Systematic troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and optimization of complex hardware systems in a research environment- Interface design and software-based integration of hardware to establish automated, scientific data collection processes- Design and scientific and technical documentation of hardware interfaces, wiring, and system architectures- Strategic Development of Reusable Experimental Platforms for Future Research Fields- Independently authoring and submitting scientific publications, playing a key role in securing third-party funding projects, and presenting research findings in scholarly discourse- Support for Teaching- Supervision and academic guidance for student projects (bachelor’s theses, master’s theses, project papers, and seminar papers), ranging from topic selection and guidance on content to assistance with evaluationYour profileFor being part of the selection process is needed:- University degree (Master or Diploma (Univ.)) in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related fieldFollowing competences are desirable:- Basic knowledge of digital and electronic systems- Programming experience in C/C++, Python, MATLAB, or comparable programming languages- Good communication skills in English; German is an advantage- Experience with FPGA development (Verilog/VHDL)- Familiarity with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, or vector network analyzers- Experience with embedded systems (e.g., Raspberry Pi, STM32, Arduino, or similar)- Knowledge of wireless communications or signal processing- Experience with Linux and Git- Interest in RF systems, embedded hardware, or measurement equipment- Self-motivated, structured working style with ability to work independently- Enjoyment of teamwork and interdisciplinary collaborationPlease provide evidence of the qualifications required for the job by certificates and references.In principle, the job is also suitable for part-time employment. The extent to which a part-time request can be granted, in particular with regard to the location and extent of part-time work, will be examined on the basis of the needs of the service.What we offer you:- attractive remuneration according to collective agreement (as per TV-L) incl. granting of a special annual payment- vacation entitlement of 30 days in the calendar year and additional days off on 24 / 31 December- family-friendly, flexible working time model- VBL - pension scheme in the public sector- wide range of individual training opportunities- extensive health and sports programs- respectful working environment at a renowned universityErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Programmiersprache Python, Programmiersprache/Software MATLAB
